The parser reads the attacker-controlled 2-byte cipher-suite vector length and returns `be16toh(cipherSuiteLen) / 2` as the advertised suite count. If the field overstates the vector, this count can exceed the number of 2-byte IDs actually present in `m_DataLen`.

The fuzz helper uses the advertised count from step 4 as the loop bound. On the staged witness the loop reaches a crashing iteration `i` and calls `clientHelloMessage->getCipherSuite(i)` at line 244; the saved stack shows the crash happens inside that call before the explicit `getCipherSuiteID(i, valid)` below it executes.

The callee revalidates the caller-supplied `index` only against the advertised suite count. For the crashing iteration from step 5 this predicate is false, so `getCipherSuiteID()` continues even though the corresponding 2-byte entry is not actually backed by enough bytes.
